messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're bringing the q-canary model family into an internal eval next week. need to trim the promptbank (sparsify) before the quant runs so we don't blow CPU during kvcache warmup. :eyes:
raj: how many prompts are we targeting post-sparsify? current bank is ~1.2M right?
maya: yep ~1.2M. target ~60k-120k depending on cohort coverage. want to bias for high-recall intents + long-context examples.
linh: propose a two-stage sparsify: (1) cohort bucketing by intent+len+anchor-hash, (2) within-cohort dedupe by semantic sim, then cap per-cohort. low-risk for recall.
ben: sounds good. we should also flag a 2k golden holdout (not touched) for quality regressions across quant configs. separate label pass for edgecases.
raj: +1 for holdout. can we run a quick sampling job to show cohort sizes?
linh: pushing a sampling script now — use this config to reproduce: 
```
# scripts/sample_sparsified_bank.sh
python tools/sample_bank.py \ 
  --input s3://redwood/promptbank/v1.2/ \ 
  --group-by intent,len_bucket,anchor_hash \ 
  --sparsity-thresh 0.12 \ 
  --sim-dedup-thresh 0.88 \ 
  --max-per-group 150 \ 
  --out s3://redwood/curation/sparsified/qcanary/
```
linh: reasoning: 0.12 sparsity gives ~8-12x reduction in dense cohorts but keeps rare intents; sim-dedup 0.88 reduces near-dup paraphrases. we can tweak after a dry run.
maya: can we make the script also emit a per-cohort summary csv (size before/after, %longctx)? makes it easier for product to review.
linh: will add `--summary-csv` flag.
aiops-bot: Created ticket INF-2221: "q-canary promptbank sparsify + golden holdout" assigned to @linh, @ben. Link: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/INF-2221
ben: labeling plan: 2-stage for the 2k golden: (A) single-pass labelers mark core-fail/ok, (B) small expert adjudication for disagreements. estimate 3 FTE-weeks if we parallelize.
raj: do we need to change tokenizer/normalize steps before dedupe? earlier runs showed tokenizer variants affect sim scores.
linh: yes — normalizing pipeline now: lowercase, unicode-normalize, strip-urls, map quotes. pass names through lm-tokenizer-v2 for sim embeddings.
maya: timeline: run sparsify job Tue morning (linh), review summary Tue afternoon (ben+raj), label golden Wed-Thu, then quant 8-bit canary Fri. can everyone ack?
raj: ack. I'll reserve the canary slot and add capacity buffer.
linh: ack. Pushing script + small test run now.
ben: ack. will set up labeling queue and tag `qcanary-golden`.
maya: thanks team — please add any blockers in INF-2221 and ping if summary shows weird cohort dropoffs. :thumbsup:
